# Dineiz

> Dineiz is an offline-first restaurant management platform providing point-of-sale (POS), digital QR menus, kitchen display systems (KDS), inventory control, and real-time cloud analytics for restaurants, cafes, food carts, and multi-branch food businesses.

## Products & Modules

- [Dineiz POS](https://dineiz.com/product/pos): Offline-first point-of-sale terminal with table layouts, split billing, thermal/Bluetooth receipt printing, and local outbox sync.
- [Dineiz Console](https://dineiz.com/product/console): Web-based management dashboard for menu engineering, staff roles, real-time sales reporting, and multi-branch management.
- [Dineiz Go](https://dineiz.com/product/go): Android mobile billing app designed for quick-service counters, street food vendors, and dhabas.
- [WhatsApp Ordering](https://dineiz.com/product/whatsapp): Automated WhatsApp conversational ordering and status notifications for customer pickup and delivery.
- [Features Overview](https://dineiz.com/features): Comprehensive feature breakdown across POS, KDS, inventory, reporting, and staff tracking.

## Industry Solutions

- [Restaurants](https://dineiz.com/industries/restaurant): Full dine-in workflows, floor plans, kitchen display sync, and table turn optimization.
- [Cafes & Bakeries](https://dineiz.com/industries/cafe): Fast counter checkout, modifier customization, barista stations, and customer loyalty.
- [Dhabas & Quick Service](https://dineiz.com/industries/dhaba): Fast cash billing, mobile receipt printing, and offline operation during network or power cuts.
- [Food Carts & Kiosks](https://dineiz.com/industries/food-cart): Single-device Android mobile POS with low-latency billing and Bluetooth printer support.

## Pricing & Deployment

- [Pricing Plans](https://dineiz.com/pricing): Tiered plans starting with Go Free (0 PKR/mo), Go Pro (999 PKR/mo), Starter (2,999 PKR/mo), Pro (5,999 PKR/mo), and Custom Enterprise. Includes 14-day free trial on paid tiers.
